chapter: Ridgley, La Vida, Piron and the Minstrels
title: Piron's band personnel and breakup, 1932-35
summary: Williams explains Piron's band broke up and was remade, and lists its members and singer Harold Wells.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What was P. Ron like then? I mean, his band broke up before.
No, well, I don't know. I wasn't here. I left in 36. He still had his band intact. Everybody but me. I don't know what happened.
No, I mean, in 32 or so.

Oh, he broke up with P. the book out there. Yeah. He just quit the band. See, he quit the band with P. the book out there. Then he made up this band. See, he consists of me, Eddie Pearson, Leo Desjard, Joe Phillips, Arthur Durbney, Elliot Taylor, Manuel Sayles, and Simon Moreira. And a singer by the name of Harold Wells. That was his band. And we played together from 32 until 35. I did.
And I left the band in 35.
